title: FlashHead Pro - Talking Head Avatars
description: One portrait + a voiceover of any length -> a 512x512, 25 fps lip-synced talking-head video with your original audio. SoulX-FlashHead Pro (1.3B, Apache-2.0): about 1.8 s of RTX 5090 time per second of video, 6.4 GB peak VRAM.

input.name: S3 bucket endpoint URL
input.description: Optional. With a bucket set, finished videos are uploaded there and the job returns a link (S3-compatible: AWS, R2, B2, RunPod S3 API).

input.name: torch.compile
input.description: Compile the model: faster chunks, but each new worker spends a few minutes warming up before its first job.

input.name: Longest video returned as base64 (s)
input.description: Without a bucket or network volume, the video comes back inside the job result; longer voiceovers are refused before rendering.

input.name: Longest voiceover per job (s)
input.description: Set the endpoint's execution timeout to at least 2x this plus a few minutes.
